# Claracle

> Claracle is a GitHub trend observatory that publishes weekly, monthly, and yearly analysis of open-source technology signals.

Site: https://claracle.com/
Primary feed: https://claracle.com/index.xml

## Key sections

- Weekly reports: https://claracle.com/weekly/
- Monthly rollups: https://claracle.com/monthly/
- Yearly analysis: https://claracle.com/yearly/
- Topic hubs: https://claracle.com/topics/
- Data pages: https://claracle.com/data/
- Repository explorer: https://claracle.com/repo/
- Methodology: https://claracle.com/methodology/
- About: https://claracle.com/about/

## Content notes

- Claracle summarizes public GitHub activity into editorial reports for developers and technology decision-makers.
- Reports may include AI-generated analysis; methodology and source framing are published on-site.
- Canonical URLs and RSS feeds should be preferred when citing or indexing site content.

## Feeds

- Main RSS: https://claracle.com/index.xml
- Weekly RSS: https://claracle.com/weekly/index.xml
- Monthly RSS: https://claracle.com/monthly/index.xml
- Yearly RSS: https://claracle.com/yearly/index.xml
